app.name: Blink
home.sub_none: No break has come due yet today
stats.legend: Blue is breaks taken, red is skipped — bar height is how many came due
settings.work_desc: Counts only the time you are actually at the screen
settings.toast_lead_desc: The corner toast, this long before the break is due
settings.short_enforcement_desc: Fullscreen takes over until it is done. Reminder puts a card in the corner and lets you carry on
settings.hold_desc: How long the skip button must be held. Set 0 to skip instantly
settings.long_enabled_desc: For actually leaving the chair, not just resting your eyes
settings.long_break_desc: Long enough to get up and walk somewhere
settings.long_enforcement_desc: Locking calls LockWorkStation, so you retype your password. Reminder mode skips the 60 second countdown entirely
settings.grace: Wait for a gap in typing
settings.grace_desc: If the break is due mid-sentence, wait for a pause — up to 2 minutes
settings.idle_threshold_desc: Below this you still count as reading the screen
settings.reset_threshold_desc: Away this long and your eyes genuinely rested
settings.sound_desc: A soft chime at the start and end of each break
settings.hud: Floating countdown when the window is away
settings.hud_desc: A small card in a corner showing time to the next break. Click it to reopen the window
settings.hud_corner_desc: Keeps clear of the taskbar automatically
settings.appearance_desc: The break screen stays dark whatever this is set to
settings.name: What to call you
settings.name_desc: Shown on the home page. Leave it blank if you prefer
settings.autostart_desc: Adds an entry to your own Startup list. No admin rights needed
settings.config_file_desc: Open config.json for the few settings that are not on this page
about.tagline: Blink {version} — a 20-20-20 break reminder. You can always skip, but every way out costs something.
about.no_hook: No keyboard hook — it knows when input happened, never what was pressed
about.no_network: No network. There is not one line of socket code in it
tray.idle: Paused — you're away from the keyboard
toast.title: Eye break coming up
popup.hint: Look away from the screen — click this card to skip
activity.look_far.title: Look far away
activity.look_far.subtitle: Focus on something at least 20 feet away, and blink slowly
activity.moving_dot.title: Follow the dot
activity.moving_dot.subtitle: Move your eyes, not your head — it works the eye muscles in a way reading never does
activity.blink_count.title: Blink slowly
activity.blink_count.subtitle: Blink along with it, closing fully each time — staring at a screen halves your blink rate
activity.breathe.title: Breathe 4-7-8
activity.breathe.subtitle: In for 4, hold for 7, out for 8. Follow the circle
activity.stretch.title: Neck and shoulders
activity.stretch.subtitle: Follow the dial, slowly, and never force it
activity.stretch.tilt: Tilt your head side to side
longwarn.title: Long break in {seconds}s
longwarn.will_lock: Your screen will be locked — save your work now
longwarn.will_overlay: A {minutes} minute break screen will appear
garden.xp: {xp} / {needed} XP to level up · {total} total XP
garden.starter_fixed: Your starter tree grows here as you level up.
garden.break_summary: Today · {completed} breaks completed · {eligible} earned Garden XP
garden.why_xp: Why do some breaks earn no XP?
garden.xp_rules: Stats include manual breaks and history from before Blink Garden. XP starts with qualifying scheduled breaks. Eye breaks need a configured interval and accrued screen time of at least {short_work}, with a rest of at least {short_rest}. Long breaks need {long_work} and {long_rest}. Rewards have cooldowns and daily limits of {short_cap} eye breaks and {long_cap} long break. Debug mode has rewards turned off.
garden.debug: Debug session · Garden rewards are turned off.
garden.hint: Choose a decoration and an empty plot to place it. Select an item on the map to move it. You can also use arrow keys, Enter and Delete.
garden.selected: Selected {item}. Choose an empty plot to move it.
garden.purchased: Bought {item}. Choose a plot to place it.
garden.quest_intro: Quests refresh at 4:00 AM. Each claim gives 30 XP and 10 Garden Coins. Scheduled breaks can count when they meet the garden’s work and rest minimums. Take breaks at your own pace.
badge.fresh_start_desc: Complete 3 eligible breaks in one day.
badge.long_rest_desc: Complete your first eligible long break.
stats.completed_modes: Today’s completed breaks · {popup} corner reminders · {enforced} fullscreen or lock screen
